paite: Huchi in ata deihtakte bang in Pathian omdan zuite hi un.
heading: Vak A Khosakna
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

paite: Huan Khrist in hon it a, namtui ding a Pathian kiang a thilpiak ding leh kithoihna ding a i sik a akipiak bang in itna ah khosa un.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

paite: Misiangthou hita na hihman un kingaihna leh siang lou tengteng huaihamna toh, na lak uah lohkhak in om kei hen.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

paite: Zahmohte, thugina lou gente, chiamnuih thu nangawn huaite akilawm lou ahi; huaite gen sang in kipahthu gen zaw un.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

paite: Kingaihhat leh mithanghuai leh mihuaiham in, mihuaiham zaw milim bemi ahi, Khrist leh Pathian lalgam ah gou tan ding anei kei uh chih na thei mahmah uhi.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

paite: Kuamah in thugina lou peuh in hon khem kei uhen; huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak hi.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Huaiziak in amau kikoppih kei un.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

paite: Tuma in mial na hi ua, tu'n zaw Toupa ah vak na hong hita uhi; vak tate bang in om un;
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

paite: vak gah tuh hoihna, diktatna leh thutak tengteng ahi;
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

paite: huan Toupa ah akipah lam pomtak bang ahi hiam zong un.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

paite: Huan mial thilhih gah nei ngeiloute ah leng panna nei kei unla, pan nak sang in adiklouhdan uh theisak zaw un.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

paite: Aguk a athilhih nakte uh agen lel leng azumhuai hi.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

paite: Himahleh thil bangkim adiklouhdan muh theih a om tuh vak hihlat ahi nak hi; muh theih a om peuhmah vak ahi ngal a.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

paite: Huaiziak in “Nang ihmu! Hak inla, misi lak a kipan thou in. Huchi in Khrist in vak hon pe ding," chih ahi.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

paite: Huan mihaite bang a om lou in, mipilte bang a om zaw in, na omdan uah pilvang un;
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

paite: nite ahoih louh ziak in hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem un.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

paite: Huaiziak in hai nuam kei unla, Toupa deihlam bang ahia chih thei zaw un.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

paite: Uain kham in om kei un, huai ah kideklouhna a-om hi; Kha a dim in om zaw un,
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

paite: phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late a kihoupih chiat a Toupa kiang a na lungtang tengteng ua ging kilawm bawl leh la sa in,
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

paite: i Toupa Jesu Khrist min a, Pathian, Pa ngei kiang a bangkim tung a kipahthu gen gige in.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

paite: Khrist laudan siam in kiniamkhiak chiat un.
heading: Khristian Inkuan Omdan Zite Leh Pasalte
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

paite: Zite aw, Toupa kiang a na kiniamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

paite: Khrist amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang ahih mah bang in zi lutang tuh pasal ahi.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte Khrist kiang a akiniamkhiak bang un bangkim ah apasalte uh kiang ah zite kiniamkhiak uhen.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

paite: Pasalte aw, na zite uh it un, Khrist in saptuamte a-it a, asik ua akipiak bang in,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

paite: huchi a ama'n tui a sil a, thu a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in;
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

paite: huchi a saptuamte nin baang lou, vuai lou leh huchibang thil mawngmawng pu lou a, siangthou leh gensiatbei a om zaw a, saptuamte amah-le-amah thupitak a akipiak theihna ding in.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

paite: Huchibang in pasalte'n leng amau pumpi mah bang in amau zite a-it ding uh ahi. Ama zi itpa amah ki-it ahi.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

paite: Kuamah in ama sa mah aho ngei kei, Khrist in saptuamte avak a adeihthoh bang in, avak in adeihthoh zaw hi;
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

paite: ama sa leh guh a pan a om, apumpi hiangte i hi ngal ua.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

paite: Huaiziak in pasal in anu leh apa paisan in azi alen tinten ding a, anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uhi.
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

paite: Hiai thuguk athupi hi, himahleh ke'n zaw Khrist leh saptuamte toh kisai ahi ka gen.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, nou lak a kuapeuh in amah a ki-it bang in azi it hen; zi mah in leng apasal zahtak ding in pilvang hen.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
